summary_ja: 2026年度HPCI公式一覧から、設置規模とは別の「課題へ提供される資源量」と一jobの最大規模を整理しました。Miyabi-G、Wisteria/Odyssey、TSUBAME4.0、SQUID、Genkai等で年間node-hourと同時利用可能node数は大きく異なります。またSirius、不老・弐、OCTOPUS、ES4、HOKUSAI BigWaterfall2への世代交代が同一年度内にも進みます。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: The official FY2026 HPCI list was used to distinguish capacity offered to projects from installed scale and to record maximum per-job scale. Annual node-hours and simultaneous node limits vary widely across Miyabi-G, Wisteria/Odyssey, TSUBAME4.0, SQUID, Genkai, and other resources. Turnover to Sirius, Flow Type II, OCTOPUS, ES4, and HOKUSAI BigWaterfall2 also proceeds within the fiscal year. Consensus is incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 2026年度HPCIの提供資源量と最大job規模
sections.title_en: FY2026 HPCI offered capacity and maximum job scale
sections.summary_ja: 設置規模ではなく、共通公募で課題に提供されるnode-hourと最大job規模を比較します。
sections.summary_en: Compare node-hours and maximum job scale offered to projects in the common call rather than installed scale alone.

items.name_ja: 提供量と一jobの最大規模は資源ごとに大きく異なる
items.name_en: Offered quantity and per-job maximum scale vary widely by resource
items.statement_ja: HPCI公式一覧では、例としてMiyabi-Gは2,903,040 node-hour・最大256 node、Wisteria/Odysseyは19,906,560 node-hour・最大2,304 node、TSUBAME4.0は428,000 node-hour・最大70 node、SQUID CPU群は6,660,000 node-hour・最大512 node、Genkai A群は3,000,000 node-hour・最大128 nodeです。Aquariusは共有で最大8 node・占有で1 node、Genkai GPU群も原則1 nodeです。device性能だけでなく、提供量と同時利用規模がapplication適合性を決めます。
items.statement_en: The official HPCI list gives, for example, 2,903,040 node-hours and a 256-node maximum for Miyabi-G; 19,906,560 and 2,304 for Wisteria/Odyssey; 428,000 and 70 for TSUBAME4.0; 6,660,000 and 512 for the SQUID CPU partition; and 3,000,000 and 128 for Genkai group A. Aquarius permits up to eight shared nodes or one exclusive node, while Genkai's GPU group is generally one node. Offered quantity and simultaneous scale, not device performance alone, determine application fit.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: application portfolioは1/4/32/128/1024 node等の需要分布を、各資源の年間提供量と最大job規模へ割り当ててcapacity gapを計算すべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Application portfolios should map demand at scales such as 1, 4, 32, 128, and 1,024 nodes to annual offered quantities and per-job maxima to calculate capacity gaps.
adoption_conditions_ja: installed capacity、HPCI提供量、他制度配分、保守予備を分離して管理する。
node数・device数別の応募量、採択量、待ち時間、未消化量を集計する。
単一node型AI負荷と超大規模simulationを同じnode-hourだけで比較しない。
adoption_conditions_en: Track installed capacity, HPCI-offered capacity, other-program allocations, and maintenance reserve separately.
Aggregate requested, awarded, queued, and unused capacity by node and device count.
Do not compare single-node AI workloads and extreme-scale simulations using node-hours alone.

items.name_ja: 2026年度中にも提供資源の世代交代が進行
items.name_en: HPCI resource turnover continues within FY2026
items.timing_ja: 2026年度、うち不老・弐は2026年10月提供開始予定
items.timing_en: FY2026; Flow Type II service scheduled from October 2026
items.statement_ja: 2026年度一覧にはSirius、OCTOPUS、地球シミュレータES4、HOKUSAI BigWaterfall2が入り、名古屋大学の不老・弐はType I（EPYC 9965）とType II（Grace CPU×2、B200×4）を2026年10月から提供予定です。同一年度内にも資源構成と提供期間が変わるため、年次snapshotだけでは移行riskを表せません。
items.statement_en: The FY2026 list includes Sirius, OCTOPUS, Earth Simulator ES4, and HOKUSAI BigWaterfall2. Nagoya's Flow Type II is scheduled from October 2026 with Type I based on EPYC 9965 and Type II on two Grace CPUs plus four B200 GPUs. Because resource composition and availability change within a fiscal year, annual snapshots alone do not expose migration risk.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: quarter単位の導入・提供開始・停止と、compiler/library/application readinessを同じroadmapで追跡する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Quarterly installation, service start, and retirement should be tracked on the same roadmap as compiler, library, and application readiness.
adoption_conditions_ja: 各資源の公募開始、試験利用、本運用、旧system停止をquarter単位で記録する。
software移植完了率と利用者trainingを提供開始条件へ含める。
予定変更時に提供node-hourと採択課題への影響を更新する。
adoption_conditions_en: Record calls, pilot use, production start, and predecessor retirement by quarter.
Include software-port completion and user training in service-readiness criteria.
Update offered node-hours and awarded-project impacts when schedules change.
